title: Job-order create options
description: Where the member may create an aUEC order through a client and how close they are to the caps on client creates. Read it when the create form opens and let the member choose both units from it; empty lists mean the client offers no create. It names no member.

requestingUnits.description: The units the member may create an order on behalf of: the active units they directly belong to and are a Logistician of.

responsibleUnits.description: The Profit units that may process an aUEC order.

suggestedResponsible.description: The id of the canonical Profit area among the responsible units, to preselect; null when no create is offered.

writesEnabled.description: Whether job-order writes are switched on; while false a create answers 503 JOB_ORDER_WRITES_DISABLED.

limits.description: The two caps on the orders a member creates through clients, with the member's own figures against them; orders created in the Basetool count for neither. Grey out the create while openOrders has reached openOrderCap or createdToday has reached dailyCreateCap.

openOrderCap.description: The most open or in-progress orders the member may hold that were created through any client; once openOrders reaches it, a create answers 409 JOB_ORDER_OPEN_ORDER_CAP until one of them closes.

openOrders.description: The member's open or in-progress orders created through any client.

dailyCreateCap.description: The most orders the member may create through clients in one UTC day; once createdToday reaches it, a create answers 409 JOB_ORDER_DAILY_CREATE_CAP until the next UTC midnight.

createdToday.description: The orders the member created through any client since the last UTC midnight, cancelled ones included.
